about.title: About Me
about.paragraph: I am a Software Engineer based in Dodoma, Tanzania, passionate about building reliable, performant, and accessible digital products. With experience delivering production-ready websites and web platforms, I handle the full lifecycle from requirements and architecture to deployment and DNS/SSL configuration. I combine strong full-stack skills with practical data analysis and machine learning knowledge to solve real-world problems.
